candidates.statement: 6 and 12 months’ duration when developing new medicinal products. As the objective of ICH is to reduce or eliminate the need to duplicate testing during development of medicinal products and to ensure a more economical use of material, animal, and human resources, while at the same time maintaining safeguards to protect public health, further scientific evaluation was undertaken.
candidates.context: The lack of harmonized duration led to the need for pharmaceutical companies to perform partially duplicative studies for both Each of the regulatory authorities in the European Union, Japan, and the United States undertook a review to determine whether a single duration for chronic toxicity testing in nonrodents could be identified.

candidates.statement: 12 months’ data should be undertaken. This evaluation was conducted as a joint exercise by the competent authorities in the three regions.
candidates.context: From this analysis, it emerged that in 16 cases a more detailed evaluation of 6 versus In some of the cases analyzed at the tripartite meetings, there were no additional findings at 12 months. For some other cases, there was not complete agreement among the regulators with respect to the comparability in study design and conduct to allow assessment of whether there were differences in the findings at 6 and 12 months due to duration of treatment alone.

candidates.statement: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is announcing the following public workshop entitled ‘‘Blood Donor Suitability Workshop: Donor History of Hepatitis.’’ The purpose of the workshop is to discuss whether prospective blood donors with a history of viral hepatitis should be deferred from donating blood.
candidates.context: Donor History of Hepatitis AGENCY: Food and Drug Administration, HHS. ACTION: Notice. Date and Time : The workshop will be held on Wednesday, July 21, 1999, 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.
